result:
Summary: The DRAGIN framework leverages the LLM's self-attention across the entire context for query formulation, rather than just the last few tokens or sentences, to determine what to retrieve. It uses the full context to generate efficient queries from external databases for continued LLM generation. The QFS (Query Formulation based on Self-Attention) component of DRAGIN formulates retrieval queries by considering the entire context. The RIND (Real-time Information Needs Detection) component identifies when the LLM requires external knowledge and triggers retrieval. The sources do not provide specific details on the entire context information need beyond these descriptions.
